name: ai-sdlc-0-bootstrap
goal: Align the repository with the intended system and prepare it for AI-SDLC.
actions: Inspect existing structure (src/, tests/), dependency files, existing code and tests.
Align Clean Architecture dirs (src/app/domain|application|interfaces|infrastructure, tests/unit|integration|e2e); create only what's missing, reuse what's compatible.
Check for a dependency manifest (requirements.txt | pyproject.toml | package.json); reuse if present, create minimal only if missing.
Ensure docs/PROJECT.md exists and is updated: purpose, architecture, structure, commands, dependencies.
Identify unused files or mismatched structure; ask the user before removing anything.

Once the project is established, strip template-only meta commentary (docs/PROJECT.md's BOOTSTRAP instruction line, README's template setup steps) and replace with the real project's own content; ask the user first.
Replace or remove template identity (README badges, CITATION.cff, .zenodo.json), which describes the template rather than the derived project; ask the user first.
